last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 final fresh non-prescription cold, cough, and nasal-care topics. The main query set returned 160 unique PubMed PMIDs, 159 fetched article records, and 158 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric effects or valid relative effects were verified for PMIDs: 29633783, 36239199, 36414647, 29441845, 31341433, 17063641, 32147070, 9443697, 28849871, 21563130, 30705369, 23372900, 22507276, 40362799, 36842634, 10589439, 16247099, 19592479, and 17914132. Eighteen retained references were new to the database; PMID 28849871 was already present. Twelve new entries across twelve qualified topics retain numeric intervention-versus-control results or valid relative effects. Elderberry, echinacea, zinc lozenges, vitamin C, and garlic topics were linked to existing entries. Honey common cold, buckwheat honey cough, marshmallow root cough, eucalyptus common cold, menthol nasal congestion, vitamin D common cold, quercetin common cold, black seed common cold, honey sore throat, salt-water gargle sore throat, acupuncture common cold, acupressure sinusitis, and handwashing common cold were screened out because the retrieved PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect.
